hero.eyebrow: Southern cooking in an old house on Georgia Avenue
hero.title: As close to *grandma's* as it gets
hero.lede: A menu that changes every day, sides straight from a 1960s cookbook, and cake in the glass cases by the door. Lunch in the dining rooms or on the porch, and catering for your gathering.

before: No website of its own: today's menu lives on Facebook, where it scrolls away
Listings disagree on whether the menu changes daily or weekly
The words on this concept come from The Augusta Press, Tripadvisor and the chamber listing; photos and hours would come from the owner
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Today's menu in one place that doesn't scroll away, and a catering request page
